cases.query: Broadband Wi-Fi disconnects every evening but my wired computer remains connected.
Broadband downloads crawl and videos buffer; I have not compared speeds on other devices.
No broadband internet on any device and the router has no visible power light.
Wi-Fi only reaches the room beside the router, with poor coverage upstairs.
My mobile data cannot connect, although voice calls still work.
Cellular voice calls drop halfway through a conversation.
My landline has no dial tone and the fixed voice service is unavailable.
The fibre terminal loses its signal intermittently and goes offline.
There is loud static on our fixed voice line whenever it rains.
Mobile LTE data stalls when my phone changes radio bands.
Our IPTV live broadcasts keep buffering and freezing.
The gateway Wi-Fi network name is no longer broadcasting.
Our VoIP handset cannot register with the SIP voice service.
Cellular voice service disappears indoors, but works outside the building.
The IPTV set-top box shows a blank picture after an HDMI handshake error.
Broadband online gaming has very high latency and noticeable lag.
Fixed voice calls have an echo and a delay in the audio.
My mobile hotspot disconnects tethered devices repeatedly.
The IPTV electronic programme guide has disappeared.
Broadband login fails with an authentication timeout.
My mobile phone cannot send MMS messages with pictures.
The IPTV surround-sound audio keeps dropping out.
Mobile roaming data is blocked while I am travelling abroad.
Our IPTV remote responds several seconds after each button press.
